Project.description: A project is a named list of components and/or sub-projects.

name.description: Name of the project; also the a2l project and module name.
name.title: Name

naming.description:
Path to the naming convention every declared name has to follow, relative to this file.

A convention belongs to the project rather than to the command line: whoever checks the
project should get the same verdict as whoever wrote it.
naming.title: Naming

includes.description:
Paths to component or sub-project files, relative to this file.

Shell style wildcards (``*``, ``?``, ``**``) are expanded; the kind of every
included file is detected from its top level key.
includes.title: Includes

Project.title: Project

description:
Root object of a ``*.ddd.json`` project description.

``project`` is the top level key that makes this a project file rather than a component,
a types or a naming file; DDD decides what a file is from that key alone, so exactly one
of the four appears here.

$schema.description: Editor binding to a schema written by ``ddd schema -o``; not interpreted by DDD.
$schema.title: $Schema

project.description: The project this file describes; the key that identifies the file as a project.

title: DDD project description
